seo.title: aiOFFICE: an AI office assistant for everyday work
seo.description: aiOFFICE collects tasks, assigns owners and deadlines, organizes documents and approvals, follows up after meetings, and prepares office reports.

hero.commitment: aiNOW maps the team's real routine, owners and approval points before aiOFFICE starts acting.
hero.audience: For teams losing time between email, chats, documents, meetings, spreadsheets, and reminders.
hero.sub: Tasks arrive from different places. aiOFFICE gathers them, assigns an owner and deadline, reminds the team, and shows the manager what is done and what is stuck.
hero.signedBy: aiNOW configures aiOFFICE around your rules and keeps important decisions under human control.

work.headingAccent: From scattered requests to a clear working day.
work.s1Desc: Requests stop disappearing between channels. aiOFFICE turns each one into a visible task in a single queue.
work.s2Desc: Approved rules route the task to the right person, set a deadline, and show who is responsible.
work.s3Desc: Files are attached to the right task, the current version stays visible, and missing information is requested before work continues.
work.s4Desc: aiOFFICE reminds the approver, records the decision, and escalates an overdue step instead of letting it disappear.
work.s5Desc: Meeting notes become assigned next steps, so agreements are not forgotten after the call ends.
work.s6Title: Show the manager what is stuck
work.s6Desc: aiOFFICE prepares a short summary of completed, overdue, waiting, and blocked work without manual spreadsheet reporting.

faq.headingAccent: before an AI office assistant starts.
faq.subtitle: What aiOFFICE organizes, what it connects to, and what stays under your control.
faq.a1: aiOFFICE is aiNOW's AI office assistant. It organizes tasks, deadlines, documents, approvals, meeting follow-ups, reminders, and reports in one visible workflow.
faq.a2: It fits teams where requests get lost, deadlines are missed, documents have several versions, approvals stall, meeting decisions are forgotten, and reports are assembled by hand.
faq.q3: Which tools can aiOFFICE connect to?
faq.a3: Depending on access, aiOFFICE can work with email, calendars, cloud storage, forms, spreadsheets, task systems, and internal business software. aiNOW confirms each connection first.
faq.a4: People approve sensitive decisions, payments, external messages, access changes, and unusual cases. aiOFFICE handles the routine around those decisions.
faq.q5: What result does the business get?
faq.a5: The business gets fewer lost tasks, clearer responsibility, faster approvals, current documents, automatic reminders, and a manager view of what needs attention.
faq.q6: Can it prepare RS.ge waybills and invoices?
faq.a6: Supported data can be used to prepare document drafts. An authorised person reviews the draft before submission or posting.
faq.a7: Storage, access and deployment are defined in the project scope. Only the systems required for the agreed workflow are included.
faq.q8: What prevents an incorrect customer or tax action?
faq.a8: Sensitive actions stay in draft. A named employee approves them, and the ready state appears only after that approval.
faq.a9: aiOFFICE handles repetitive movement of information. Employees keep approval, exception handling and business decisions.
faq.q10: What happens when a source format changes?
faq.a10: The workflow stops unsafe steps and exposes the exception. Monitoring and the support response are defined in the operating scope.
faq.a11: Ownership, access, documentation and handover conditions are defined in the agreement before implementation starts.
faq.q12: Is a small team suitable for aiOFFICE?
faq.a12: Team size is not the main test. The useful signal is a repeatable process that moves the same information between people or systems.
faq.q13: How is value evaluated without speculative savings?
faq.a13: The project selects an operational measure such as missing orders, correction volume, processing delay or record mismatch and reviews it on real data.
faq.q14: Which aiNOW product fits the process?
faq.a14: aiOFFICE covers internal workflows. aiDOCS handles document-heavy work, aiSTAFF supports chat, and aiCALL supports phone workflows.

capabilities.title: What aiOFFICE fixes in everyday office work
capabilities.intro: Ten common office problems are reduced through five simple working systems.

1.title: No lost requests or unclear owners
1.description: Collects tasks from different channels and assigns each task to a responsible person with a deadline.
1.result: Every request has a visible owner and next step.

2.title: No missed deadlines or forgotten follow-ups
2.description: Sends reminders, escalates overdue work, and turns meeting decisions into assigned follow-up tasks.
2.result: Important work does not disappear after a meeting or busy day.

3.title: No document chaos or wrong versions
3.description: Keeps files with the correct task, shows the current version, and requests missing information.
3.result: The team works from the same document and sees its status.

4.title: No stalled approvals or status chasing
4.description: Routes approvals, records decisions, reminds the right person, and shows where work is blocked.
4.result: Managers see the bottleneck without asking every employee.

5.title: No manual weekly reports or repeated searching
5.description: Builds daily and weekly summaries and finds approved internal information from the connected workspace.
5.result: The manager gets a clear update without another spreadsheet.
